currentBehavior.persona: Fixed native-QQ whale adaptation; catalog/commands/per-member selection removed.
currentBehavior.typing: 偏短，一般懒得打字 is a tendency; all lengths and echoes of humans allowed.
currentBehavior.learning: Current module plus chronological records; thinking high, budget8192. Reasonable feedback is merged, preserved and applied to replies.
currentBehavior.roles: Chat: user=members, assistant=our actual sent messages. Learning: role=assistant and speaker=bot are explained explicitly; human memberN IDs are anonymous.
currentBehavior.participation: Interest, mood and current public discussion; no question, at or bot-conversation intent required. Learned reply-method instructions do not gate joining.
currentBehavior.scheduling: Per-group serial accumulation, first pending deadline kept; ongoing human messages do not cancel inference. New messages during final check remain queued for next cycle.
currentBehavior.ownRepeats: Local exact own-reply guard enabled; semantic review disabled after legitimate follow-up false positive. Semantic repetition remains governed by prompts.

fullConversation.scope: This full 100-message run predates the later proactive-interest/scheduler change. Current participation behavior is verified separately in proactive-interest-final; it is not falsely attributed to this archived run.

learning.quality: The search rewrite keeps source/uncertainty and uses conversational wording, but its introductory role-card summary still has some processing/narration feel. Deterministic reviewed-source fixtures; not a live fetch success.

proactive.inference: Both prompts accepted all 12 public samples. This does not prove the model itself was passive in the real group. Strict snapshot invalidation/debounce are concrete code barriers; source/runtime tests verify the fix without claiming a statistically superior prompt.

restrictionAB.conclusion: No clear liveliness improvement established by this small subjective A/B. Persona and layers changed together; chosen to match explicit user preferences, not claimed causal proof.

semantic.reason: Repeatedly classified a legitimate change-of-comparison follow-up as self-repeat; disabled by default.

protocolFailure.reason: JSON word missing in experimental prompt; corrected, failed run preserved.
